nodes.n: Final day. At one end of the stadium, behind the stands, a wedding mandap glows with ten thousand fairy lights. The Sethis planned it as the night's second trophy.

nodes.t: Rookie. Number five tonight. If it's close, it's going to be you. It's always going to be you now.
Big night, small town. You bat, I get married. By midnight, I'll own your contract. Literally.

choice.t: "Check your palms tonight. Look for a K."

nodes.n: The Falcons make 191. Kunal makes 4 and walks off without looking at anyone. You come in at eleven for four.
Forty-one balls later, it comes down to this. Last over. Twelve to win. Shaun Mathers, the fastest bowler in the league, polishing the ball.

msgs.t: They gave me my phone back for the wedding photos.
I'm in the mandap. I can see the big screen from here.

moment.title: 12 off 6
moment.desc: The final. Shaun Mathers. Seventy thousand people. A wedding mandap glowing behind the stands. Twelve to win.

nodes.n: The last ball climbs over long-on and lands somewhere near the mandap. Seventy thousand people lose their minds. The Monarchs are champions.
Three runs short. The Falcons are champions. You sit down on the pitch and put your face in your gloves. The money that could save the team is gone.
Then the big screen cuts to the mandap camera. The crowd starts to roar again, louder.
A bride in a red lehenga, holding her skirts in both fists, is running out of the mandap, across the concourse, down the stairs. Towards the pitch.

nodes.cliff: Meera Malhotra just left her own wedding. In front of seventy thousand people.
